question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick/full GitHub PR templates as the contributor PR authoring contract, or keep the single default template until maintainers revise the workflow?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but the linked issue is marked as needing product direction and the change affects how contributors and proof automation structure PR bodies.

options.title: Accept after proof refresh
options.body: Approve this template direction once the contributor adds current-head rendered proof and the branch is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Revise the template contract
options.body: Ask for maintainer-specified quick/full template wording before merge so proof, contributor, and review expectations stay aligned.

options.title: Keep one default template
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want multiple selectable PR templates in the core repository workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof refresh
recommendation.body: Approve this template direction once the contributor adds current-head rendered proof and the branch is refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged work owns the current PR template and proof-policy surface that this change extends.
